_description: Avrae's "Everyone roll for initiative!" after `!init begin`. Classified IRRELEVANT when it was first captured, because §3.1's handoff had no trigger and this looked like harmless chatter. It is in fact one of the two boundaries the whole handoff hangs on: seeing it is how Gary knows to freeze the wall clock.

message.content:
Everyone roll for initiative!
If you have a character set up with SheetManager: `!init join`
If it's a 5e monster: `!init madd <monster name>`
Otherwise: `!init add <modifier> <name>`
